fusions.name: Sabre Pass
fusions.desc: Rides you to a target up to 7 tiles away, then deals 13 damage and leaves it 10% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Unflagging Arc
fusions.desc: A wide cut that deals 7 damage to everything within 3 tiles ahead of you. Holds 4 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Long Canter
fusions.desc: Increases your movement speed by 30% for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Fresh Legs
fusions.desc: The moment your stamina is full, your crit chance rises by 20% for your next strike. Once every 15 seconds.
